description: PHP class defining command-line tasks for running various test suites (install, API, acceptance, unit) in a SuiteCRM environment, utilizing Robo task runner and Symfony Console InputOption.

classes.name: TestRunCommands
classes.description: Defines CLI commands for executing different test suites in SuiteCRM environment.

methods.name: TestsInstall
methods.description: Runs the install test suite with optional debug and fail-fast flags.

methods.name: TestsAPI
methods.description: Runs the API test suite with optional debug and fail-fast flags.

methods.name: TestsAcceptance
methods.description: Runs the acceptance test suite with optional debug and fail-fast flags.

methods.name: TestsUnit
methods.description: Runs the PHPUnit unit test suite with optional debug, fail-fast, and filter flags.
